We need answer Chinese econ multiple choice. Need analyze. Question: If point elasticity at every point on supply curve equals 1, then supply curve can only be a ____
Options:
A. 45-degree line through origin
B. straight line through origin
C. horizontal line
D. vertical line

Need determine. Price elasticity of supply = (dQ/dP)*(P/Q). For point elasticity =1 everywhere. Differential equation dQ/dP = Q/P => d ln Q / dP = 1/P => ln Q = ln P + const => Q = c P. That is a straight line through origin (if c>0). In price-quantity graph, horizontal axis Q, vertical P? Usually price vertical, quantity horizontal. Q = cP => P = (1/c) Q, straight line through origin. Not necessarily 45-degree line because slope depends on units; 45 line if P=Q? In graph with same units/scale? Economics often a straight line through origin has unit elasticity at every point. A 45-degree line through origin is a special case (slope 1 in coordinate units), but only if axes same scale and Q=P. The correct general is B. Need final 答案：B.
Need maybe provide concise explanation in Chinese. Ensure final last line exactly format.
content:
设供给的价格点弹性为：

\[
E_s=\frac{dQ}{dP}\cdot \frac{P}{Q}
\]

若供给曲线上每一点的点弹性都等于 1，则：

\[
\frac{dQ}{dP}\cdot \frac{P}{Q}=1
\]

即：

\[
\frac{dQ}{Q}=\frac{dP}{P}
\]

积分可得：

\[
Q=kP
\]

这说明供给曲线是一条过原点的直线，但不一定是 45 线，因为斜率取决于系数 \(k\)。

答案：B
